summary.text: Peggy Balboni is the incumbent Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 38, in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists her tenure in the House as beginning in 2022, and she is a teacher.

paragraphs.text: Balboni earned a B.S. in psychology from Georgetown University and an M.A. in special education from Columbia University.
Her career experience includes working as a public school teacher.
She served on the Rye School Board, on the Rye Budget Committee, and as chair of the grants committee of the Rye Education Foundation.
